gbm_population_evidence.quote: Other solid tumors (e.g., non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, carcinoma of unknown primary) with the exception of rapidly progressing neoplasms (e.g., pancreatic cancer, glioblastoma, hepatocellular carcinoma)

candidate_evidence.quote: HC 5404-FU (hemi fumarate salt of HC 5404) is a novel, highly selective, and potent PERK inhibitor.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: have received a minimum of 2 (and no more than 5) lines of prior therapy for metastatic (Stage IV) disease

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: biomarker parameters will also be assessed
willing to provide fresh tissue for biomarker analysis

role_evidence.quote: HC 5404-FU will be orally administered BID every day with food or within 30 minutes of completing a meal, starting at 25 mg

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational PERK inhibitor (hemifumarate salt of HC-5404)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PERK inhibition; decreased viability of tumor cells

source_quote.quote: Human epidermal growth factor receptor positive (HER2+) MBC (metastatic breast cancer)

coder_notes: Glioblastoma appears only as an exclusion (rapidly progressing neoplasms) in a solid-tumour phase 1 trial, so gbm_excluded and basket false. Candidate fields filled as if screening passed. Tissue biopsies at baseline and after Cycle 3 are planned for biomarker analysis, but no pharmacodynamic objective linked to PERK is stated, so target engagement is unclear. PK is plasma only. HER2+ applies only to the MBC cohort and is not linked to a PERK inhibitor.
